packageRules.description: Auto-merge low-risk updates (pin/digest/patch/minor) once required checks pass — keeps the queue self-clearing.
Group all GitHub Actions bumps into a single PR.
Keep Go module directives current through reviewed product-org pull requests.
Permit direct remediation of the vulnerable transitive archive module.
Major bumps are breaking — never auto-merge; leave for review.

Hold goldmark on v1: v2 (yuin/goldmark/v2) is 'still in the early stages of release' per its README, replaces the New/WithExtensions API markdown/ builds on, and third-party extensions lag. Revisit when v2 is declared stable.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Refresh lockfiles so transitive CVE fixes (e.g. brace-expansion, fast-uri under tools/spectral) land without Dependabot; Renovate updates direct deps only otherwise.
